worldcombat.skill.psywave.summary: Push an unstable psychic wave front at the target: it pierces a line of foes, dealing special damage to each it passes, and its intensity is rerolled every cast - the ring count and brightness in the picture show how strong this one is.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.use.0: Punch through several targets lined up
worldcombat.skill.psywave.use.1: Chip with a cheap shot and gamble on a high roll
worldcombat.skill.psywave.use.2: Play as a steady ranged attack in steady mode
worldcombat.skill.psywave.description.0: Base wave power %1$s; each cast rolls an intensity between (1 - %2$s) and (1 + %2$s) of it, so how much this one deals changes every time.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.description.1: The front travels %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks/tick with a %3$s block hit width.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.description.2: The front pierces up to %1$s targets; the picture's ring count is based on %2$s and rises or falls with this cast's intensity.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.surge.on: Surge mode: power x1.2 and swing x1.5 for wilder high and low rolls, with 3 ticks faster recovery, at the cost of unchanged reach and no cooldown discount.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.surge.off: Steady flow: power x0.88 and swing x0.5, with x1.1 reach and -3 ticks cooldown - stable and long.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.growth.0: From level %1$s base wave power rises to %2$s and pierce to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.growth.1: From level %1$s base wave power rises to %2$s and swing falls to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psywave.preference.sur: On: power x1.2 and swing x1.5 for wilder high and low rolls, with 3 ticks faster recovery, at the cost of unchanged reach and no cooldown discount. Off (steady): power x0.88 and swing x0.5, with x1.1 reach and -3 ticks cooldown.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before pushing a wave; larger values let it open from further away.
On: when other non-allies stand near the target, prioritise a wave that can pierce through them. Off: ordinary ranged ordering.
